# datagecko_metric (Resource)

An instance of a metric type: a named, id-addressed use of it in the organization. Connect it to a stream with datagecko_stream_metric when the type has per-stream params.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datagecko_metric" "freshness" {
  type   = "freshness"
  name   = "Freshness"
  params = jsonencode({ warning_after = 2, critical_after = 7 })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique in the organization, case-insensitively; at most 64 characters.
- `type` (String) The metric type's key (see the datagecko_metric_types data source). A change replaces the metric.

### Optional

- `params` (String) The instance's params, exactly as given; they replace the previous ones whole. A JSON object; write it with jsonencode().

### Read-Only

- `effective` (String) The type's defaults with params laid over them.
- `id` (String) The metric's UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the metric's id.
terraform import datagecko_metric.freshness 7c0e2b91-...
```
